tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a group with the caller as its first admin. Idempotent by client id (a retry changes nothing). Three results: group, membership, activity.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups (id, slug, name, description, avatar_url, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:group_id, :slug, :name, :description, :avatar_url, :__user_id, :__now, :__now)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO group_members (id, group_id, user_id, display_name, role, joined_at, invited_by) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, :display_name, 'admin', :__now, NULL FROM groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND g.created_by = :__user_id

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'group.created', json_object('name', :name), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND g.created_by = :__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_log a WHERE a.group_id = :group_id AND a.action = 'group.created')

display_name.description: The caller's display name in the group

tools.name: list_my_groups
tools.description: Groups the caller belongs to, with their role and member count.
tools.sql: SELECT g.id, g.slug, g.name, g.description, g.avatar_url, g.created_by, g.created_at, g.updated_at, m.role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_members c WHERE c.group_id = g.id) AS member_count FROM groups g JOIN group_members m ON m.group_id = g.id WHERE m.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY m.joined_at LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: One group the caller belongs to, with the caller's role.
tools.sql: SELECT g.id, g.slug, g.name, g.description, g.avatar_url, g.created_by, g.created_at, g.updated_at, m.role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_members c WHERE c.group_id = g.id) AS member_count FROM groups g JOIN group_members m ON m.group_id = g.id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE g.id = :group_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Edit name, description or avatar (group admin). Audited.
statements: UPDATE groups SET name = :name, description = :description, avatar_url = :avatar_url, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin'))

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'group.updated', json_object('name', :name), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND g.updated_at = :__now) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin'))

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: Members of a group the caller belongs to.
tools.sql: SELECT gm.user_id, gm.display_name, gm.role, gm.joined_at, gm.invited_by FROM group_members gm WHERE gm.group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY gm.joined_at LIMIT 500

tools.name: add_member
tools.description: Add a user directly by id (admin or moderator), as a member. Idempotent; audited.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO group_members (id, group_id, user_id, display_name, role, joined_at, invited_by) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :user_id, :display_name, 'member', :__now, :__user_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'member.added', json_object('user_id', :user_id), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members t WHERE t.group_id = :group_id AND t.user_id = :user_id AND t.invited_by = :__user_id AND t.joined_at = :__now)

tools.name: set_member_role
tools.description: Change a member's role (group admin only; admin | moderator | member). Never your own, so a group keeps its last admin. Audited.
statements: UPDATE group_members SET role = :role WHERE group_id = :group_id AND user_id = :user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND :role IN ('admin', 'moderator', 'member') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin'))

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'member.role_changed', json_object('user_id', :user_id, 'role', :role), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members t WHERE t.group_id = :group_id AND t.user_id = :user_id AND t.role = :role AND t.user_id != :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin'))

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member: admins remove anyone but themselves; moderators remove plain members. Their RSVPs in the group go too. Audited.
statements: DELETE FROM rsvps WHERE user_id = :user_id AND event_id IN (SELECT e.id FROM events e WHERE e.group_id = :group_id) AND :user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members t WHERE t.group_id = :group_id AND t.user_id = :user_id AND (t.role = 'member' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin')))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))

DELETE FROM group_members WHERE group_id = :group_id AND user_id = :user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND (role = 'member' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'member.removed', json_object('user_id', :user_id), :__now WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members t WHERE t.group_id = :group_id AND t.user_id = :user_id) AND :user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))

tools.name: leave_group
tools.description: Leave a group. The last admin cannot leave — hand the role over first.
tools.sql: DELETE FROM group_members WHERE group_id = :group_id AND user_id = :__user_id AND (role != 'admin' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members o WHERE o.group_id = :group_id AND o.role = 'admin' AND o.user_id != :__user_id))

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Set the caller's display name in a group they belong to.
tools.sql: UPDATE group_members SET display_name = :display_name WHERE group_id = :group_id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: create_join_code
tools.description: Make a join code (admin or moderator). It grants the role you choose (member | moderator), for max_uses redemptions, until expires_at. Idempotent by client id.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO join_codes (id, group_id, code, role, created_by, expires_at, max_uses, use_count) SELECT :id, :group_id, :code, :role, :__user_id, :expires_at, :max_uses, 0 WHERE :role IN ('member', 'moderator') AND :max_uses >= 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))

max_uses.description: How many people may redeem it

tools.name: list_join_codes
tools.description: Live join codes of a group (admin or moderator).
tools.sql: SELECT id, code, role, created_by, expires_at, used_at, used_by, max_uses, use_count FROM join_codes WHERE group_id = :group_id AND use_count < max_uses AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > :__now) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator')) ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

tools.name: revoke_join_code
tools.description: Delete a join code (admin or moderator).
tools.sql: DELETE FROM join_codes WHERE id = :id AND group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))

tools.name: join_group_by_code
tools.description: Redeem a join code: the membership is granted with the code's role and the use is consumed in the same batch. An expired, exhausted or unknown code — or an existing membership — changes nothing.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO group_members (id, group_id, user_id, display_name, role, joined_at, invited_by) SELECT :__uuid, j.group_id, :__user_id, :display_name, j.role, :__now, j.created_by FROM join_codes j WHERE j.code = :code AND j.use_count < j.max_uses AND (j.expires_at IS NULL OR j.expires_at > :__now)

UPDATE join_codes SET use_count = use_count + 1, used_at = :__now, used_by = :__user_id WHERE code = :code AND use_count < max_uses AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > :__now) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members m WHERE m.group_id = join_codes.group_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.joined_at = :__now)

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, (SELECT j.group_id FROM join_codes j WHERE j.code = :code), :__user_id, 'member.joined', json_object('code', :code), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM join_codes j WHERE j.code = :code AND j.used_by = :__user_id AND j.used_at = :__now)

display_name.description: The caller's display name in the group

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Events of a group the caller belongs to, soonest first; `past` = 1 lists finished ones instead. Includes counts and the caller's RSVP.
tools.sql: SELECT e.id, e.group_id, e.title, e.description, e.location, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.capacity, e.created_by, e.created_at, e.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.status = 'going') AS going_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.status = 'waitlist') AS waitlist_count, (SELECT r.status FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.user_id = :__user_id) AS my_status FROM events e WHERE e.group_id = :group_id AND ((:past = 1 AND e.starts_at < :__now) OR (:past = 0 AND e.starts_at >= :__now)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY CASE WHEN :past = 1 THEN -e.starts_at ELSE e.starts_at END LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event with counts and the caller's RSVP.
tools.sql: SELECT e.id, e.group_id, e.title, e.description, e.location, e.starts_at, e.ends_at, e.capacity, e.created_by, e.created_at, e.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.status = 'going') AS going_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.status = 'waitlist') AS waitlist_count, (SELECT r.status FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.user_id = :__user_id) AS my_status FROM events e WHERE e.id = :id AND e.group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) LIMIT 1

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create an event (admin or moderator). Idempotent by client id; audited.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO events (id, group_id, title, description, location, starts_at, ends_at, capacity, created_by, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :group_id, :title, :description, :location, :starts_at, :ends_at, :capacity, :__user_id, :__now, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'event.created', json_object('event_id', :id, 'title', :title), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.id = :id AND e.group_id = :group_id AND e.created_by = :__user_id AND e.created_at = :__now)

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Edit an event (its creator, or admin / moderator). Audited.
statements: UPDATE events SET title = :title, description = :description, location = :location, starts_at = :starts_at, ends_at = :ends_at, capacity = :capacity, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND group_id = :group_id AND (created_by = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id)

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'event.updated', json_object('event_id', :id, 'title', :title), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.id = :id AND e.group_id = :group_id AND e.updated_at = :__now) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event and its RSVPs (its creator, or admin / moderator). Audited.
statements: DELETE FROM rsvps WHERE event_id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.id = :id AND e.group_id = :group_id AND (e.created_by = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator'))))

DELETE FROM events WHERE id = :id AND group_id = :group_id AND (created_by = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator')))

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :group_id, :__user_id, 'event.deleted', json_object('event_id', :id), :__now WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.id = :id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: rsvp_event
tools.description: RSVP going or not_going. Going lands on the waitlist when the event is full; a freed seat promotes the first waitlisted member in the same batch. Only for events of a group the caller belongs to. Audited.
statements: UPDATE rsvps SET status = CASE WHEN :status = 'not_going' THEN 'not_going' WHEN (e.capacity IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps o WHERE o.event_id = e.id AND o.status = 'going' AND o.user_id != :__user_id) < e.capacity) THEN 'going' ELSE 'waitlist' END, waitlist_position = CASE WHEN :status != 'not_going' AND NOT (e.capacity IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps o WHERE o.event_id = e.id AND o.status = 'going' AND o.user_id != :__user_id) < e.capacity) THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(w.waitlist_position), 0) + 1 FROM rsvps w WHERE w.event_id = e.id AND w.status = 'waitlist') ELSE NULL END, created_at = :__now FROM events e WHERE e.id = rsvps.event_id AND rsvps.event_id = :event_id AND rsvps.user_id = :__user_id AND :status IN ('going', 'not_going') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = e.group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rsvps (id, event_id, user_id, status, waitlist_position, created_at) SELECT :id, e.id, :__user_id, CASE WHEN :status = 'not_going' THEN 'not_going' WHEN (e.capacity IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps o WHERE o.event_id = e.id AND o.status = 'going' AND o.user_id != :__user_id) < e.capacity) THEN 'going' ELSE 'waitlist' END, CASE WHEN :status != 'not_going' AND NOT (e.capacity IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps o WHERE o.event_id = e.id AND o.status = 'going' AND o.user_id != :__user_id) < e.capacity) THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(w.waitlist_position), 0) + 1 FROM rsvps w WHERE w.event_id = e.id AND w.status = 'waitlist') ELSE NULL END, :__now FROM events e WHERE e.id = :event_id AND :status IN ('going', 'not_going') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = e.group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id)

UPDATE rsvps SET status = 'going', waitlist_position = NULL WHERE id = (SELECT w.id FROM rsvps w JOIN events e ON e.id = w.event_id WHERE w.event_id = :event_id AND w.status = 'waitlist' AND (e.capacity IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvps o WHERE o.event_id = e.id AND o.status = 'going') < e.capacity) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = e.group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY w.waitlist_position LIMIT 1)

INSERT INTO activity_log (id, group_id, user_id, action, metadata, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, (SELECT e.group_id FROM events e WHERE e.id = :event_id), :__user_id, 'event.rsvp', json_object('event_id', :event_id, 'status', (SELECT r.status FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = :event_id AND r.user_id = :__user_id)), :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rsvps r WHERE r.event_id = :event_id AND r.user_id = :__user_id AND r.created_at = :__now)

tools.name: list_rsvps
tools.description: Who is going and who is waitlisted, for members of the group.
tools.sql: SELECT r.user_id, (SELECT gm.display_name FROM group_members gm WHERE gm.group_id = e.group_id AND gm.user_id = r.user_id) AS display_name, r.status, r.waitlist_position, r.created_at FROM rsvps r JOIN events e ON e.id = r.event_id WHERE r.event_id = :event_id AND r.status != 'not_going' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = e.group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY r.status, r.waitlist_position, r.created_at LIMIT 500

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: The group thread, newest first, keyset-paginated (pass the last row's created_at as `before`).
tools.sql: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, (SELECT gm.display_name FROM group_members gm WHERE gm.group_id = m.group_id AND gm.user_id = m.user_id) AS display_name, m.content, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM messages m WHERE m.group_id = :group_id AND (:before IS NULL OR m.created_at < :before) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post to the group thread (any member). Idempotent by client id.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO messages (id, group_id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :group_id, :__user_id, :content, :__now, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message: your own, or any as admin / moderator.
tools.sql: DELETE FROM messages WHERE id = :id AND group_id = :group_id AND (user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id AND me.role IN ('admin', 'moderator')))

tools.name: list_activity
tools.description: The group's activity log, newest first.
tools.sql: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, (SELECT gm.display_name FROM group_members gm WHERE gm.group_id = a.group_id AND gm.user_id = a.user_id) AS display_name, a.action, a.metadata, a.created_at FROM activity_log a WHERE a.group_id = :group_id AND (:before IS NULL OR a.created_at < :before) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members me WHERE me.group_id = :group_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: admin_list_groups
tools.description: App-wide moderation list of every group with member counts. Only for holders of the app's `admin` role (app.roles); unscoped by design.
tools.sql: SELECT g.id, g.slug, g.name, g.created_by, g.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_members c WHERE c.group_id = g.id) AS member_count FROM groups g ORDER BY g.created_at DESC LIMIT 500

caller_unscoped.reason: app-wide moderation catalogue of groups with aggregate member counts, for the app's admin role only; no per-user row data

tools.name: admin_delete_group
tools.description: App-wide moderation: delete a group and everything in it. Only for holders of the app's `admin` role; the deletion is recorded in the app logs by the caller.
statements: DELETE FROM rsvps WHERE event_id IN (SELECT e.id FROM events e WHERE e.group_id = :group_id)
DELETE FROM events WHERE group_id = :group_id
DELETE FROM messages WHERE group_id = :group_id
DELETE FROM join_codes WHERE group_id = :group_id
DELETE FROM activity_log WHERE group_id = :group_id
DELETE FROM group_members WHERE group_id = :group_id
DELETE FROM groups WHERE id = :group_id

caller_unscoped.reason: app-wide moderation delete across every table of one group, for the app's admin role only; the gate is auth.app_roles, not a membership predicate
